Thanks for taking this — Verdant Labs is ready to be added to Redwood's supplier roster. From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding request — Verdant Labs

Hi Elena — great to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for the intake file. I attached our standard onboarding packet which lists the canonical fields we capture and our PO routing rules. Quick checklist to help the vendor master team create the record cleanly:

- Legal entity name (must match W-9 / tax docs)
- DBA or trading name (optional)
- EIN / Tax ID & tax classification
- Registered legal address + remit address if different
- Primary AP contact (name/email/phone)
- Default PO contact (name/email) and invoice routing target (e.g., invoices@verdantlabs.com)
- Bank details for ACH/wire (use our bank_standards.xlsx template if possible)
- Authorized signer name and title (for PO/contract signatures)

If you can provide the W-9 and bank template back to Naomi (cc'ed) we'll get the vendor master created and map the PO channel. Naomi — can you confirm whether we should route POs to the default "Procurement" ERP queue or set up a vendor-specific PO contact?

Elena: attaching the onboarding packet and our bank template for clarity.

Next steps:
1) Elena: send W-9 + completed onboarding form + bank file (as attached template)
2) Naomi: create vendor master record, set remit and PO routing
3) Marcus: quick legal check on the entity name and signature authority

Goal: vendor master + PO routing by 10/25.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_onboarding_packet.pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding request — Verdant Labs

Jordan / team — happy to own the vendor master creation. A couple of clarifying items from AP: 

- We prefer bank details in the attached standard template (bank_standards.xlsx).
- For PO routing: if Verdant provides a named PO contact, we can map POs to that contact (recommended). If they do not, we'll default to the Procurement ERP queue (ProcureOps).
- Please confirm the remit address — sometimes vendors use a separate lockbox for invoices.

I'll hold the record in draft until I receive: W-9 (matching entity name), remit address, and the completed bank_standards.xlsx.

Also flagged: if Verdant is paying via a third-party processor we need a certificate of third-party authorization. Marcus, any legal concerns on accepting an unsigned W-9 scanned PDF?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Accounts Payable Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding request — Verdant Labs

Thanks — a few legal notes:

- Entity name on the W-9 must be the one we use on our contract. If Verdant has a parent/subsidiary structure, we need an indication of which legal entity Redwood is contracting with.
- For signature authority: we accept scanned signatures on vendor-signed forms for onboarding, but if the contract value exceeds $250k or involves data residency commitments, escalate for wet signature.
- Beneficial ownership: per our policy, for US entities we request the BOI disclosure form if annual payments are expected to exceed $100k. Let's ask Verdant to provide that if applicable.

I don't see any blockers otherwise. Naomi, please proceed with draft vendor creation once the W-9 is received.

-Marcus
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
